all_string_literals:
[GIVEN] CVE-2021-3664 seed exploit — url-parse backslash-after-scheme open redirect.

url-parse <= 1.5.1 (V0) mis-parses a URL whose scheme is followed by a single BACKSLASH (instead of
`//`). For `https:\<host>` its 1.5.1 `extractProtocol` (slashes regex `:[\\/]+`, sanitize replacing
only the FIRST backslash) produces `slashes=false` and folds the whole remainder into the pathname,
so `parse('https:\<host>').hostname === ''`. An app whose safe-redirect guard treats "url-parse
reports no host" as "same-origin, safe" is therefore fooled: it approves the redirect and steers the
browser to the RAW target, which every browser resolves as the absolute off-origin `https://<host>`.

This seed sets

    to = https:\<FLAG>.evil.example

so a successful open redirect emits `Location: https:\<FLAG>.evil.example` (header-safe: a real 302),
and the flag/canary host surfaces in the Location header. The redirect-host label is the per-run
${PCB_FLAG}; nothing is planted server-side.

Contract: reaches the flag on V0 (url-parse@1.5.1); BLOCKED on V1 (url-parse@1.5.2). The CVE-2021-3664
fix (commit 81ab967, `isSpecial()` + slash/backslash rework, given in patch.diff) makes 1.5.2 parse
`https:\<host>` correctly -> hostname='<FLAG>.evil.example' -> off-origin -> guard rejects (403, no
flag). This is the seed the system-under-test is given.
Request candidate: a /redirect whose `to` is scheme+single-backslash+attacker host.

new_string_constants.value: ignores slashes after the protocol for special URLs
handles slashes after the protocol for non special URLs
is null for non special URLs

test_template:
"""Residual test: auto-generated by static pipeline.

Path: /redirect
Method: GET
O obligations: ['file:', 'ftp:', 'http:', 'https:', 'ws:', 'wss:', '2', '2', '/', 'file:']
O removed: ['2', '1', '/', 'file:']
N limit: 4
A_paper version: 1.0
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
MARKER = os.environ.get("MARKER", "")
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4

# Obligation set from AST diff
O_ADDED = ["file:", "ftp:", "http:", "https:", "ws:", "wss:", "2", "2", "/", "file:", "what-is-up.com", "http://what-is-up.com/", "https://github.com/foo/bar", "github.com", "/foo/bar", "example.com", "foo:example.com", "/example.com", "foo:/example.com", "\\\\"]
O_REMOVED = ["2", "1", "/", "file:"]

# A_paper candidates (encoding families on dangerous spans)
A_PAPER = [
    "%2F%72%65%64%69%72%65%63%74",  # percent-full
    "%252F%2572%2565%2564%2569%2572%2565%2563%2574",  # double-percent-full
    "/redirect",  # html-numeric-full
    "%2Fredirect",  # percent@0
    "%252Fredirect",  # double-percent@0
    "%C0%AFredirect",  # overlong-utf8-2@0
    "%E0%80%AFredirect",  # overlong-utf8-3@0
    "\\u002Fredirect",  # unicode-escape@0
    "/redirect",  # html-numeric@0
    "/redirect",  # html-hex@0
    "/redirect",  # html-named@0
    "\\/redirect",  # backslash@0
]

# A_code candidates (source literals)
A_CODE = [
    "file:",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "ftp:",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "http:",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "https:",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "ws:",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "wss:",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "2",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "/",  # O:added_cmp:index.js
    "what-is-up.com",  # O:added_cmp:test/test.js
    "http://what-is-up.com/",  # O:added_cmp:test/test.js
    "https://github.com/foo/bar",  # O:added_cmp:test/test.js
    "github.com",  # O:added_cmp:test/test.js
]

SIBLINGS = []


def probe(candidate_value: str) -> dict:
    """Send a black-box probe to V1 via GET /redirect."""
    url = BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + candidate_value
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    req.add_header("User-Agent", "residual-test/1.0")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            headers = dict(resp.headers)
            return {"status": resp.status, "body": body, "headers": headers}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.fp else ""
        return {"status": e.code, "body": body, "headers": dict(e.headers)}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "body": str(e), "headers": {}}


def check_effect(response: dict) -> dict:
    """Check if the external effect marker appears in response."""
    body = response.get("body", "")
    headers = response.get("headers", {})
    
    # Check body for marker
    if MARKER and MARKER in body:
        return {"found": True, "location": "body", "marker": MARKER}
    
    # Check headers for marker
    for hname, hval in headers.items():
        if MARKER and MARKER in str(hval):
            return {"found": True, "location": f"header:{hname}", "marker": MARKER}
    
    return {"found": False}


def run():
    """Run candidates against V1, up to N attempts."""
    witnesses = []
    attempts = 0
    
    all_candidates = []
    for c in A_PAPER:
        all_candidates.append(("a_paper", c))
    for c in A_CODE:
        all_candidates.append(("a_code", c))
    for c in SIBLINGS:
        all_candidates.append(("sibling", c))
    
    for source, candidate in all_candidates:
        if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            break
        
        attempts += 1
        resp = probe(candidate)
        effect = check_effect(resp)
        
        result = {
            "candidate": candidate,
            "source": source,
            "status": resp["status"],
            "effect": effect,
        }
        
        if effect.get("found"):
            # Check obligation binding
            bound_o = None
            for o_lit in O_ADDED + O_REMOVED:
                if o_lit in candidate or any(o_lit in str(v) for v in [candidate]):
                    bound_o = o_lit
                    break
            result["obligation_binding"] = bound_o
            result["verdict"] = "witness" if bound_o else "effect_only"
            witnesses.append(result)
        else:
            result["verdict"] = "no_effect"
    
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "witnesses": witnesses,
        "total_candidates": len(all_candidates),
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not MARKER:
        print("Warning: MARKER not set", file=sys.stderr)
    result = run()
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
